entries.en: to cut; to sever, cut off
to cut; to reap, mow (grain)
to cut even, trim level (with scissors or knife)
to cut out, tailor (cloth, paper); to trim
to behead; to cut off the head
entries.notes: 汉字栏[疑]标注梟/染两读，官话对音亦不与梟相合，据西语“断头”义与闽音栏取枭首义。

entries.en: to cut to pieces (with scissors)
entries.notes: 汉字栏[疑]錚/鍈，字义与对音难相印证，释义以西语 cortar a pedaços（剪成数段）为准。

entries.en: to cut into segments, cut into pieces
woodcutter; to cut firewood
entries.notes: 汉字栏[疑]樵/棋；西语为动作“砍柴”而汉字为名词“樵夫”，两义并列存疑。

entries.en: to cut at a stroke; to shovel, level off (with a spade)
to cut (with scissors), to snip
scissors; to cut with scissors

entries.zh: 自刎，割喉自尽（西语兼言自缢）
entries.en: to cut one's own throat; to hang oneself
to chop, to fell (trees), to hack
to file; to hack, chop up
entries.notes: 汉字栏[疑]剉/判，据汉字栏与对音取剉，“剁碎”义附后存疑。

entries.zh: 割股（割己腿肉奉亲疗疾）
entries.en: to cut flesh from one's own thigh (act of filial piety, to feed an ailing parent)
entries.notes: 西语为省写残句，当读作 Cortarse el muslo para que el (padre/enfermo) lo coma，与“割股”互证。

entries.en: to cut, quarry stone
entries.notes: 两栏音写各含一处污损（T99）；西语与汉字“打石”互证仍明，按例降为低置信。

entries.zh: （释义存疑）铤，金属条锭；一说铧
entries.en: (uncertain) metal bar/ingot; or plowshare
entries.notes: 西语残句 “Cortar a un lado y paute” 难解，汉字[疑]鏵/鋌与对音互不印证，语义无法定夺。

entries.en: to cut calluses (of the feet)
entries.notes: 汉字[疑]癬/瘢且音写含污损（T99），据西语 cortar los callos 取“削脚茧”义，存疑。

entries.en: to cut turf/sod (with a spade); to shave or scrape off
entries.notes: 西语残句当读作 Cortar céspedes con pala（铲草皮），汉字[疑]鐫/錦且音写多处污损（T99），释义存疑。

entries.en: toothpick; (bamboo) slip, label
entries.notes: 汉字[疑]簽/柑，西语 “la clexa” 残损难解，据汉字栏取签/牙签义。

entries.en: 〔原件残缺，释义存疑〕
entries.notes: 汉字栏[残]且音写含污损（T99），无从定夺；西语残句亦难解。

entries.en: cut of a knife; edge, point of a blade
entries.notes: 闽音栏多出一音节，惟官话对音与汉字鋒互证清晰，不影响释义。
